      "observations": [
        "Parent/root read all 26 owned paths and 1603 full-show lines in contiguous sections 1–400, 401–800, 801–1200 and 1201–1603 sections. Four native-error changes make this human cleanup functional, not a bulk exclusion. No changed test path or new test assertion exists.",
        "EWS and Graph DoCheckConnectivity convert OnStartRunningUrl status to a Result and propagate failure before request construction/sending. The wrapper returns native nsresult. Fixed accepted callers retain this conversion. The existing EWS start-status lesson is reused; a returned URI is distinct from later completion. No failing listener was executed.",
        "Historical EwsOutgoingServer::forget_password replaces an ignored ForgetPassword status followed by Ok with to_result directly. Fixed shared outgoing code retains it after username/type/endpoint-host lookup. The move does not prove all callers or protocols unchanged.",
        "SafeUri replaces Display with TryFrom<SafeUri> for String and propagates GetSpec failure before formatting its output. The Graph log uses its endpoint rather than SafeUri Display. Fixed conversion retains this boundary with newer raw-mut pointer syntax. Engine behavior/failure injection remains unpaired.",
        "The owned generators add must_use to constructors and reference-accessor functions, use anonymous Operation lifetimes and terminate select/extend calls with semicolons. Corresponding generated files also use explicit imports and inline format captures. Two crate warning lints support post-generation cleanup. These scoped changes do not authorize manual generated-file editing or claim all pedantic warnings were fixed.",
        "The fixed constructor template retains must_use, but Operation/type-generator organization changed and ms_graph_tb Cargo now inherits workspace lints. No current global lint severity or universal generated-getter behavior is inferred. Those later migrations remain separate work.",
        "Manual review separates Rust attributes, named format captures, safe-wrapper result types and generated provenance from JavaScript preferences. Existing generated prose typos remain historical. No native, Cargo/Clippy/build/test or broad compatibility check ran.",
        "The full current Bug1978176 original, read earlier by A, is reused under original325de699… identity/time. Its initial minimal-change intent does not apply to the later pedantic patch: numbered9 explicitly identifies minor functional fixes. This exact source owns that later phase, not every tracker landing. No raw body or independent confirmation is duplicated.",

The local log-call nit is applied without becoming a global formatting rule.",
